Title: Product structured data has a doubled URL
Description: The Product JSON-LD 'url' and offer 'url' repeat the product path.
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open any product page. 2. View page source. 3. Find script type=application/ld+json with @type Product. 4. Read 'url'.

Title: Every product shows a placeholder 5-star rating and review
Description: Product JSON-LD includes aggregateRating 5 (count 5) and a review with author 'person' on one-of-a-kind used items that have no visible reviews.
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open any product page. 2. View page source. 3. Inspect Product JSON-LD aggregateRating and review.
Expected: No rating data unless real reviews exist
Notes: May conflict with Google structured-data rules; route to legal@ezcorp.com for review

Title: Radius options differ between location controls
Description: The header 'Set Location' sheet and the Wizzy store filter offer different radius ranges and defaults.
Steps to reproduce: 1. Open the header location sheet and note radius options. 2. Open the Wizzy 'Shop By Location' filter and note slider range and default.
Actual: Header: 1, 25, 50, 75, 100 mi (default 25). Wizzy sliders: min 5 or 10, max 60, step 5, defaults 35 and 50
Confidence: Seen in page HTML; needs rendered-browser check
